subject.title: fix(secrets): resolve active exec refs locally

question: Should the canonical fix resolve only active exec-backed paths locally and keep remaining paths gateway-owned, as this PR does, or resolve the whole mixed target set locally?
rationale: Both open PRs fix the log flood, but they establish different permanent credential execution boundaries for mixed-source commands.

options.title: Adopt the split boundary
options.body: Use this PR’s narrower per-path approach after correcting unrecovered failure diagnostics.

options.title: Adopt whole-target local resolution
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96661 and move the full mixed target set to local resolution whenever an active exec ref exists.

recommendation.title: Adopt the split boundary
recommendation.body: Use this PR’s narrower per-path approach after correcting unrecovered failure diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: The command/gateway SecretRef architecture and most central resolver history trace to this owner.
